title: Telemetry Tracking-Plan Item Schema
description: Validates one concrete telemetry tracking-plan file under telemetry/<theme>/<artifact>/{kind}.{plane}[.{measure}].json. Local shape only: path mirroring, kind/plane/measure coherence with the file name, wagon ownership resolution and acceptance linkage are cross-artifact validator concerns (src/telemetry-plan.ts).
$comment: Shipped by the telemetry profile (planner_telemetry_plan). The capability is deliberately inert until a repository adopts it: no telemetry/ root and no acceptance telemetry declaration means no findings. `signal` in acceptance.schema.json keeps the executable bar (signal.metric + signal.threshold); the descriptive arrays it also carries are superseded by the acceptance `telemetry` block and by this registry, and are not renamed here — that migration is a separate, documented step.

id.description: Concrete telemetry URN: telemetry:{kind}:{plane}:{theme}:{artifact}[:{measure}]. Must mirror the file's path and name; the validator checks that coherence.

version.description: SemVer core for this item's contract. Changing properties, required or forbidden_properties is a contract change and must bump it.

logical_artifact.description: The stable architectural identity of the observable outcome: telemetry:{theme}:{artifact}. Not an exporter event. Must be owned by exactly one wagon's produce[] telemetry entry.

measure.description: Required for metric items (and only metric items); must match the measure segment of the file name and of the id.

instrument.description: Metric instrument type per the telemetry kind vocabulary.

unit.description: Unit of measure for metric items (ms, s, bytes, percent, count).

owner.description: The wagon slug that owns the logical artifact. The validator checks it equals the wagon whose produce[] declares the logical artifact.

purpose.description: The question this item answers. A tracking plan is read by people deciding what to alert and dashboard on; an item that cannot state its question is not planned.

items.description: Acceptance URNs that require this item. Each must resolve to a declared acceptance in the plan.

properties.description: The fields this item may carry, by name. `required` names must all appear here.

required.description: Property names that must be present on every emission.

forbidden_properties.description: Property names that must never be attached to this item (raw payloads, secrets, prompts).

dimensions.description: Metric labels. Every dimension declares cardinality; high cardinality is forbidden for metrics — use an event, log or trace property instead.

classification.description: Who may see the value. PII forces a justification nobody has to reconstruct later.

cardinality.description: Distinct-value volume. High cardinality is legal in event, log and trace properties where justified; never as a metric label.
